response.sql: WITH name_averages AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS average_budgeted_amount FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) AS overall_average FROM name_averages), kept AS (SELECT n.event_name, n.average_budgeted_amount, o.overall_average FROM name_averages AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.average_budgeted_amount > o.overall_average) SELECT event_name, average_budgeted_amount, average_budgeted_amount - overall_average AS difference_from_overall_average, average_budgeted_amount / (SELECT AVG(average_budgeted_amount) FROM kept) AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept;
